# 關於運行 LVHI Brigand 穿梭機的提示 - 發電機組的最佳 [bold]目標功率[/bold] (kW) 為 [color=#a4885c]8 [bold]kW[/bold][/color]。 If you've added additional machines, check shuttle [bold]APC units[/bold] to monitor the shuttle's power draw and adjust the generator's [bold]Target Power[/bold] accordingly. For more general information on the power grid and other life support systems, refer to the [textlink="Power" link="Power"] guidebook article and the [textlink="Preflight Checklist" link="PreflightChecklist"/]. - 駕駛艙內有兩個按鈕：那個帶有黃黑邊框的按鈕用來控制窗戶百葉窗。 那個帶有灰色邊框的按鈕用來切換推進器與陀螺儀。
